vulnerable_code:
class TelehealthRoomChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    # Fails to verify that current_user is the appointed physician or patient
    stream_from "room_#{params[:room_id]}"
  end
end
diagnosis: TelehealthRoomChannel establishes a WebSocket broadcast feed using unvalidated room_id parameters. Malicious users can eavesdrop on live medical consultations, chat transcripts, and biometric data exchanged between doctors and patients.
corrected_code:
class TelehealthRoomChannel < ApplicationCable::Channel
  def subscribed
    consultation = Consultation.find_by(room_token: params[:room_id])
    unless consultation && (consultation.doctor_id == current_user.id || consultation.patient_id == current_user.id)
      reject
      return
    end

    stream_from "room_#{consultation.room_token}"
  end
end
